title: Tracing the Messy Middle: A Runtime Transaction Schema for AI Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI coding agents are increasingly integrated into software development, yet the field lacks a systematic feedback loop to improve their behavior in practice. Artifact datasets capture final outputs such as code patches, commits, and benchmark outcomes, but omit the messy middle of the development lifecycle: the failed retries, fallback strategies, routing decisions, and abandoned sessions that determine operational cost, reliability, and productivity.   We propose an observability framework that captures these runtime behaviors as structured transaction records, enabling engineering coaching grounded in behavioral evidence, workflow optimization at the stages where tasks break down, and routing policy iteration measured by total task cost rather than per-request price. translated_title: 追踪“混乱的中间过程”：面向AI编码代理的运行时事务模式
translated_abstract: AI编码代理正日益融入软件开发，但该领域仍缺乏一个系统性的反馈循环来在实践层面改进其行为。现有的工件数据集只捕获最终输出，如代码补丁、提交和基准测试结果，却遗漏了开发生命周期中“混乱的中间过程”：失败的重试、回退策略、路由决策以及被中途放弃的会话——这些因素恰恰决定了运营成本、可靠性和生产力。我们提出一个可观测性框架，将这些运行时行为捕获为结构化的事务记录，从而实现基于行为证据的工程辅导、在任务易失败阶段进行的工作流优化，以及以总任务成本而非单次请求价格来衡量的路由策略迭代。我们定义了这一架构所需的运行时事务模式，并通过Agent Token Manager（Atm）这一本地优先的原型系统展示了初步可行性。
tldr: 本文提出一个可观测性框架，将AI编码代理开发过程中通常被忽视的运行时行为（如重试、回退、路由决策和放弃的会话）记录为结构化事务数据，从而支持基于行为证据的工程辅导、工作流优化和以总任务成本为导向的路由策略改进。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an observability framework that captures AI coding agents' overlooked mid-process runtime behaviors—retries, fallbacks, routing decisions, and abandoned sessions—as structured transaction records, enabling evidence-based engineering coaching, workflow optimization, and routing policy iteration measured by total task cost.
